Task 19: this method is no longer a version owner and no longer a content writer. It copies the CURRENT artifact into a .versions snapshot -- not one byte of content changes -- yet it used to run working_paper.file_version += 1, which both invented a version indistinguishable from its predecessor and made a fourth writer contend for the same counter as WOPI PutFile, the offline upload and the structure save. The snapshot name now follows the counter that actually moves (content_revision, advanced only by the ContentMutationService CAS) and this method only reads it. The return payload reports content_revision / snapshot_of_revision instead of a new_version it invented; there is no frontend caller of POST /save-version, and the only backend consumer returns the dict verbatim.
